title: Reading lab: Mark 2:1–12
subtitle: Read a compact healing scene in stages.
overview: This extended lab returns to Mark 2:5 and adds narrative setting, objections, and a public response. Read it as a sequence of paragraph moves.
Work in stages: scene, arrival, declaration, objection, question, command, response. Do not attempt a single unbroken English paraphrase first.

items.grc: καὶ ἔρχονται φέροντες πρὸς αὐτὸν παραλυτικὸν αἰρόμενον ὑπὸ τεσσάρων.
items.en: And they come, bringing to him a paralytic carried by four men.

items.grc: ἵνα δὲ εἰδῆτε ὅτι ἐξουσίαν ἔχει ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ... λέγει τῷ παραλυτικῷ· ἔγειρε.
items.en: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority ... he says to the paralytic, “Rise.”
